title: Dual Laser Cannon
caption: Dual Laser Cannon (V)
game_text: Deploy on your T-47. May target a character or vehicle for free. Draw destiny. Character hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +2 > defense value. Vehicle hit if destiny +X > defense value, where X = T-47 pilot’s ability (maximum 5).
lore: Sund x2-100 laser cannon. Popular among outlaw organizations because it is both cheap and powerful. Frequently mounted on T-47 airspeeders.
copyright: TM & © 1996 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1996 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Non-unique. The wiki's default 'Dual Laser Cannon' page carries Glossary 2.0 errata text; the printed face is 'Dual Laser Cannon (Original)' (same lore/destiny/set). The 745 px Hoth-L-duallasercannon.gif is the PC Errata face (D-E1) — downloaded, not used; 350 px decipher-archive used. Lore matches the scan. Modern: Virtual Block 2 only (VB2 -pre, 350; non-pre also downloaded). Copyright 1996 legible on the 745 face.
